limitations: L4 is offline synthetic fixture acceptance only; no real-cohort, causal, physical or clinical validation.
No genotypes, LD reference, gene mapping or true independence/replication assessment.
Hash-bound declarations cannot establish historical freeze timing or real source independence.
Single synthetic fixture: replicated status is refused.

Conservative English whole-word prefix families (case insensitive): caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Also refuses truth, physical validity and patient benefit; includes negations and is incomplete for unlisted paraphrases.
Missing or unavailable citations require unavailable claims, never negative evidence; computed agreement and review approval cannot support positive claims.
Artifacts are read-only and bounded per inode: 64 MiB each, 256 MiB total, 4,000,000 pre-parse JSON values per bundle.
